en-US.DESC_KL_CAPTURE: Press a key to add or remove it. Press Escape to cancel.
en-US.KL_SYNC_LOCKED: Key Viewer manages these keys (Sync Keys to Key Limiter is on).
en-US.KL_CHART_NOTE: Adds a Key Limiter event to the level editor. From a chosen tile, a chart can cap how many different keys you use and decide what an extra press does: ignore it, end the run, or fire tagged events. Reopen the level after changing this.
en-US.DESC_CHARTKEYLIMITER_ENABLE: Lets levels use a Key Limiter event and applies it while you play.
